question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, ORDER_DATE
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
    WHERE IS_DELIVERED = TRUE AND ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
),
periods AS (
    SELECT 'H1' AS PERIOD, DATE '2025-01-01' AS PERIOD_START, DATE '2025-07-01' AS PERIOD_END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'H2', DATE '2025-07-01', DATE '2026-01-01'
),
orders_with_period AS (
    SELECT d.CUSTOMER_ID, p.PERIOD
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN periods p ON d.ORDER_DATE >= p.PERIOD_START AND d.ORDER_DATE < p.PERIOD_END
),
repeat_customers AS (
    SELECT PERIOD, CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT PERIOD, CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT
        FROM orders_with_period
        GROUP BY PERIOD, CUSTOMER_ID
    )
    WHERE DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT >= 2
)
SELECT PERIOD, COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) AS REPEAT_CUSTOMER_COUNT
FROM repeat_customers
GROUP BY PERIOD
ORDER BY PERIOD;

action.answer: In January–June 2025 (H1), there were 94,251 repeat customers (customers with at least two delivered orders in that period). In July–December 2025 (H2), there were 95,899 repeat customers (evaluated separately for that half-year). The second half of 2025 (H2) had more repeat customers than the first half (H1).
action.reason: The counts were calculated by identifying customers with at least two delivered orders within each half-year period, as defined by the reporting policy. H2 exceeded H1 by 1,648 repeat customers.
